acceptance_criteria: C1 the first rail deploy restores the verified workstation dump into a fresh cluster, migrates 061->064 and bootstraps the graph through idempotent one-shots, and goes healthy within the declared wait budget
C2 every client authenticates with its own credential; a revoked or unknown token is refused (401) and counted in mcp_auth_refused; admin rights exist only through a time-boxed elevation
C3 /version on red-base reports the released version, git sha and image digest exactly
C4 red-backup runs and drills against the red-base brain green, and the recovery contract v22 binding in the image matches the deployed digest
C5 the workstation database stays read-only and restorable as the rollback until the operator retires it after the post-cutover follow-up (G12)
C6 rail check green through release before the operator's go; deploy, observe and learn green after the cutover and the second release
C7 search reranks through the hosted Voyage reranker (OpenRouter) from the first deploy; BRAIN_RERANK_BACKEND=none is the tested rollback and leaves search serving unreranked
constraints: Every deployment to red-base goes through red-rail; no hand docker compose except the operator's recorded empty-volume retry
MCP, metrics and every database stay off the public internet: WireGuard bind plus per-client bearer
No window work between 00:55 and 03:00 UTC (red-backup night run)
contract.objective: Move brain-v42 production off the workstation to red-base as release 0.6.9, deployed exclusively through red-rail (private-compose), with per-client credentials replacing the shared MCP bearer.
